Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local

Class ValueSetResolver

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.ValueSetResolver
public class ValueSetResolver extends Object
Resolves a value set URL to the code system version it evaluates over and the VclExpression that defines its members. It handles the SNOMED CT implicit value set forms (all-concepts, reference set, is-a, and ECL) on both unversioned and edition/version-qualified SNOMED URIs, and VCL implicit value set URLs. Content that is absent from the store resolves to Optional.empty(), so the caller applies the unknown-content fallback.
Author:
John Grimes

    • resolveCodeSystemVersion

      @Nonnull public Optional<String> resolveCodeSystemVersion(@Nonnull String url, @Nullable String requestedVersion)
      Resolves a code system URL and optional version to the stable identifier of a stored code system version. An explicit version selects exactly that version; an absent version selects the default per the version-ordering rules. This backs both value set resolution and the per-coding operations (lookup, subsumes, translate).
      Parameters:
      url - the code system canonical URL
      requestedVersion - the requested version, or null for the default
      Returns:
      the stable system version identifier, or empty if the system or version is absent from the store
      Throws:
      AmbiguousVersionException - if an unversioned SNOMED reference cannot select a single default edition
